note: Provisional and unvalidated: rules from literature, tagged PROPOSED as AI-005 requires. Changing a value here needs a deploy, not a code change. Decimal values are strings.

compulsory_towage.source: Conservative interim value. Egyptian Ministry of Transport, https://www.mts.gov.eg/en/port/%D9%85%D9%8A%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D8%AE%D9%8A%D9%84%D8%A9/ (>=1000); Alexandria Port Authority, https://apa.gov.eg/en/alex-port-navigation-data/ (>2000). To be confirmed with the Alexandria Port Authority.

block_coefficient.source: DEC-20 fallback when the request's block_coefficient is missing or outside the valid range. Default 0.85 is conservative for other or unknown types.

displacement.source: DEC-20: displacement = LOA x beam x draught x Cb x 1.025 (sea water, t/m3). LOA instead of LBP slightly overestimates, accepted as conservative.

mass_bollard_pull.source: BP = 60 x displacement / 100,000 + 40. Formula and example (10,000 t gives 46 t) checked on 2026-11-03 at https://www.seanews.com.tr/authors/cahit-istikbal/what-is-bollard-pull-and-how-to-calculate-it/162591/, which calls it a rough minimum and names neither Hensen nor ship types. Attribution to Hensen, Tug Use in Port (IMO MSC.1/Circ.1101), and the limit to tankers and bulk carriers are cited by the requester, not checked.

loa_bands.source: MPA Singapore Tug Assignment Guidelines, rev. 11 Feb 2025, https://www.mpa.gov.sg/api/media/c3d47522-816b-4197-b4f2-8bbaa3f87097/tug_assignment_guidelines.pdf, checked on 2026-11-03: the column for vessels with power (1S, 2S, 2M, 2B; S from 10 t, M from 17 t, B from 25 t). bp_floor is N x the minimum, derived by DEC-20; MPA doesn't state it. Upper limits are inclusive, so a decimal LOA between bands takes the higher band. To be replaced by the Alexandria Port Authority's own table.

large_vessel.source: MPA Singapore Tug Assignment Guidelines, rev. 11 Feb 2025, https://www.mpa.gov.sg/api/media/c3d47522-816b-4197-b4f2-8bbaa3f87097/tug_assignment_guidelines.pdf, checked on 2026-11-03: the column for vessels with power (4B; 4B of at least 45 t at draft 17 m or more). bp_floor is derived as above. Applies when LOA is above the last band or GT is at least gt_min.
